recovery_paths.authority: execution token, locked job, retry count/classifier

recovery_paths.authority: execution token and explicit delay
recovery_paths.behavior: no upstream replay until next claim; no duplicate row

recovery_paths.behavior: certification authority is rejected; cancellation terminalized; recovery count limits

recovery_paths.authority: mandatory typed authority, explicit IDs from REC-005/007/008, row lock/status; certification requires exact session and a matching FULL_PIPELINE root in a live or STALLED recoverable state
recovery_paths.behavior: no ambient ID-only path; terminal roots cannot grant recovery; no new job, same row

recovery_paths.behavior: requested-cancel terminalized; unauthorized certification rows reported untouched; may replay current stage

recovery_paths.authority: typed authority + worker instance

recovery_paths.authority: process/worker/supervisor leases

recovery_paths.authority: pipeline ID, resumable state, frozen authority

recovery_paths.authority: child/root relationship and job terminal result

recovery_paths.authority: prediction scope, causality, continuation depth/coalescing

recovery_paths.authority: evidence watermark/current refresh state/idempotency
recovery_paths.behavior: NORMAL scheduler only; manual API also available; generation locks prevent double publish

recovery_paths.authority: run/plan/scope/refresh, item status

recovery_paths.initiator: CERI backfill/reprocess/recalculate APIs and controlled replay service
